# The event editor's Resource select has its label above, the others beside

## Context

Ada's defect-note (A2A, 2026-11-21 03:10Z, from #21723's frames) and the frame critique of PR #21773 both record it: in the scheduler's event editor (`examples/scheduler/basic`, every theme, 1280 and 390 px), Title, Start, End and Progress carry their labels beside the input, and Resource carries its label above a filled box. #21744 kept it out of scope.

## The Problem

`EventEditor#createForm` (`src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs:300-332`) builds Title, Start, End and Progress from the TextField family, whose default `labelPosition` is `'left'` with a 150 px label (`src/form/field/Text.mjs:197-216`). Resource is a `Neo.form.field.Select`, which extends `field.Base` and has no `labelPosition`: its vdom is label, select, error (`src/form/field/Select.mjs:96-100`), and `.neo-selectfield` is a flex column (`resources/css/src/form/field/Select.css:1-5`). So the one field a person picks from breaks the editor's label column.

## The Architectural Reality

- TextField's label API: `labelPosition_` (validated by `beforeSetEnumValue` against `static labelPositions`), `labelWidth_` written to the label node, and a `label-<position>` class.
- `Neo.board.CardEditor` puts every field's label on top (`src/board/CardEditor.mjs:681-690`), so its two selects already match; the scheduler editor is the one mixed form.
- Ada's note names two ways out: a label-left look for the select family, or Resource as a ComboBox. A ComboBox swaps the native control (and its phone picker) for a custom one, so the select keeps its control and gains the layout.

Design authority: TextField's `labelPosition_='left'` default, which the editor's other four fields follow; Ada's defect-note.

## The Fix

- `Neo.form.field.Select` gains `labelPosition_` (`'top'` by default, or `'left'`) and `labelWidth_` (150, applied while the label is left), with TextField's names, enum check and `label-<position>` class. `Select.css` lays a left label out as two columns, with the error under the select.
- `EventEditor`'s Resource field sets `labelPosition: 'left'`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.form.field.Select#labelPosition_` (new, reactive) | TextField's `labelPosition_` (`src/form/field/Text.mjs`) | `'top'` (default): the label above the select, no class added. `'left'`: adds `label-left`; the label stands beside the select, `labelWidth` wide, and an error sits under the select | Any other value: `beforeSetEnumValue` keeps the current position and logs the supported values | The config's JSDoc | `unit/form/field/Select.spec.mjs`, `component/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` |
| `Neo.form.field.Select#labelWidth_` (new, reactive, 150) | TextField's `labelWidth_` (150) | The width of the label column while `labelPosition` is `'left'`: a number in px, a string as given, so a percentage resolves against the field as in a TextField. A hidden label, or one above the select, sets no column | — | The config's JSDoc | `unit/form/field/Select.spec.mjs`, `component/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` (37.5% of 400 px is 150 px) |
| `Neo.form.field.Select.labelPositions` (new static) | TextField's `static labelPositions` | `['left', 'top']`, the list `beforeSetEnumValue` checks | — | The member's JSDoc | `unit/form/field/Select.spec.mjs` (an unknown position) |
| `Neo.timeline.EventEditor` Resource field (`resourceId`) | The editor's other fields, label-left by TextField's default | `labelPosition: 'left'` | — | — | `e2e/scheduler/EventEditor.spec.mjs` |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In `examples/scheduler/basic`'s editor, Resource's label and select start where Title's label and input start (within 1 px), at 1280 px and at 390 px.
- [ ] AC-2: A select without `labelPosition` renders as before: label above, and `CardEditor`'s Status and Lane unchanged.
- [ ] AC-3: `labelPosition` switches between `'left'` and `'top'` at runtime, and any other value keeps the current one.
- [ ] AC-4: With its label left, a select's error shows under the select.

## Out of Scope

- Other label positions for the select (`'bottom'`, `'inline'`, `'right'`).
- The editor's 150 px label column at 390 px.
